admission.justification: A typed proof guards exact captured ordering and storage meanings; independent tree/column sort implementations would misalign the item the developer is following.

applicability: Subject and location ordering in the intent-review change-set model for the active Changed or All view.
conditions: Priority orders highest recorded meaning effect in tiers (retire/weaken/replace, then strengthen/restore/introduce/split/merge, then clarify, then none), change kind (removed, changed, added, code changed, joined/left, unknown, unchanged), descending changed-entry count, descending summed changed-entry spans, then text id.
Authored keeps outline order, families first; other sorts use their own declared primary key and Priority ties.
A family takes its first-ranked member place, except the model also admits its own changed record key; repeated family membership draws a subject once in the reading column, at its first occurrence.

Changed locations precede folded locations; within each collection role order is primary-authority, enforcement, propagation-persistence, support, presentation, unclassified, proof, then descending span, path and entry id.
The Sort preference keeps review.tree-order.v1; stored triage means Priority, authored means Authored, unknown or unreadable storage means Priority.
exclusions: L183 judgment sorts and judgment grading.
Treating family headings as subjects with their own location entries.
Changing the reading column when the tree filter narrows rows.
